queries.query: ti:"Gumbel-Sinkhorn" OR ti:"Computational Optimal Transport" OR ti:"Learning Latent Permutations"

records.title: Learning Latent Permutations with Gumbel-Sinkhorn Networks
records.use: Primary evidence that differentiable latent permutation inference is a valid structured mechanism; C165 uses exact enumeration because K=5 makes the assignment space finite and avoids an extra relaxation.

records.title: Computational Optimal Transport
records.use: Primary OT reference for couplings, discrete transport costs, and entropic/Gibbs transport; C165 keeps the finite coupling explicit and makes the source mass part of the cost.

queries.query: all:"energy score" AND (all:"probabilistic forecasting" OR all:"trajectory prediction")

records.title: Multivariate Forecasting Evaluation: On Sensitive and Strictly Proper Scoring Rules
records.use: Supports reporting complementary strictly proper scores rather than optimizing Energy alone.

records.title: Probabilistic Symmetry for Multi-Agent Dynamics
records.use: Supports treating multimodal trajectory outputs as an exchangeable probability measure over structured agents; C165 retains the finite support and changes only its measure-aware matching.

local_deduplication.C162: Uniform assignment-cost Gibbs transport plus TPMO; retained as a control and unchanged solver.
local_deduplication.C163: Risk-pattern empirical Dirichlet calibration; failed by discarding continuous actor-specific probabilities.
local_deduplication.C164: Global 5x5 row-stochastic proper-score kernel; nearly identity and only marginally improved C162.
local_deduplication.C165_difference: The assignment posterior itself is mass-aware: each actor's full B0 probability vector weights the exact permutation transport cost. No global calibration head is fitted.

coverage_limitations: The retrieval is targeted primary arXiv evidence, not a systematic review, patent review, or universal novelty claim.
